audit_items.proof_trace: When endSlot < minStartSlot, the function returns nil parameters causing the handler to silently close the stream without sending any error response. The P2P specification requires returning ResourceUnavailable (error code 3) for ranges outside the serve window, but the code sends nothing.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends data_column_sidecars_by_range request with StartSlot=1000, Count=100 when minStartSlot=2000. The handler closes stream silently instead of returning ResourceUnavailable error, violating spec and potentially causing peer sync issues.
